content:
**An unreadable document in the sourced SDD tab is never present nor done (#1282)**

buildSourcedSddTab (brain/scripts/ui/change-route.mjs) treated state 'unreadable' as present because it only excluded missing/deleted; both origin (ls-tree failure or refuse()) and worktree sources then drew the stage as done. Fix: unreadable => present false, detail 'could not be read: <reason>'. Class sweep: it was the only negative state check over documents in ui/ and status/; every other consumer uses a positive allow-list. Lesson: derive presence from an allow-list of states, never from a deny-list, when a state can also be unreadable. Found by the #1279 cold review.
